681-5226-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5226-6621-8345.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat from step 2.

4677-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 green Elemental creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5078-5741-6965-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4477-5478-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4477-5478-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.
4477-5478-5531-5694-8110.notes:
If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Greenwarden of Murasa and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

628-7189-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

728-2770-5571--6.description:
Use Donate to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4682-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2557-4682-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Parallel Lives
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

3652-3661-5861-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
3652-3661-5861-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
341-3532-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

4178-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
4178-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate three Forests by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers three times, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
4178-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

2440-4927-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4927-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

275-2034-2452-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2438-3175-3605-4812.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

147-3967-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

874-1170-1329-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-6633.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2034-3490-5572-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2034-3490-5572-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-2457-4321-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

2558-5226-6291-6757.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Weapons Manufacturing triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat from step 2.
2558-5226-6291-6757.notes: You can sacrifice the Munitions tokens to Lithatog to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

2281-3175-4050.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan, adding one mana of any color.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4871-5226-6291.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

2281-5147-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1846-2930-3525.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Portent Tracker.
Portent Tracker does not have summoning sickness.
1846-2930-3525.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Portent Tracker.
Repeat from step 2

719-1429-4779-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
719-1429-4779-5402.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

930-3781-4659-4973.description:
Cast Universal Automaton from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

4875-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
4875-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Conspiracy, Wick triggers, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
Repeat step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if the combo is not interacted with.

222-2732-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {B}.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher, adding {R}.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Slimefoot and Squee from exile to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning Slimefoot and Squee and Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1809-3603-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Returned Pastcaller
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Returned Pastcaller
When Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

204-776-2100.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer Class is at least level two.
You control at least five creatures without summoning sickness.
204-776-2100.description:
Activate five creatures you control by tapping them, adding {4}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells, or to gain a Class level.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}, triggering Jeskai Ascendancy's first and second abilities and Sorcerer Class's third ability if it is level three.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, causing Searing Touch to deal an amount of damage to each opponent equal to the number of instants and sorceries you've cast this turn.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, allowing you to loot.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control six or more creatures without summoning sickness, this combo nets near-infinite mana.

2882-4050-4783.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is in the command zone.
Infinite Reflection attached to Hellkite Courser.
You have enough mana available to cast your commander, including commander tax, if applicable.
2882-4050-4783.description:
Cast your commander from the command zone by paying its mana cost plus commander tax, if applicable.
Your commander enters the battlefield as a copy of Hellkite Courser due to Infinite Reflection, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing your commander, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have your commander returned to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the trigger from step 2, returning your commander from the command zone to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3693-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to any creature you control.
3693-5220-5243.description:
Cast Walking Ballista by paying {0}.
Walking Ballista dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Walking Ballista on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Walking Ballista from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

3272-4222-4289-4832.notablePrerequisites: Immovable Rod does not have summoning sickness.
3272-4222-4289-4832.description:
Cast Ensoul Artifact enchanting Immovable Rod.
Cast Freed from the Real enchanting Immovable Rod.
Activate Immovable Rod by tapping it to add {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U} to untap Immovable Rod.
Immovable Rod triggers, venturing into the Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Each time you trigger the Dark Pool room ability, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

864-1539-1750-2397-3603.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 15 more life than your starting life total.
864-1539-1750-2397-3603.description:
0 Ajani to wipe all your opponent creatures and artifacts.
Cast Pull from Eternity targeting Ajani to return it to graveyard.
Cast Cloudshift targeting Eternal Witness to return Cloudshift and Ajani to hand.
Cloudshift Eternal Witness to return Coudshift and Pull from Eternity to hand.
Cast Ajani and use either ability for life/creature.
Repeat every turn.

45-813-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
45-813-1987-2510.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Khalni Gem and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Khalni Gem enters the battlefield, return two lands you control to your hand if able.
Repeat.
